name: smwpatches-one-file-one-player
title: One File, One Player
description:
This patch limits the game to one save file and one player, making it so on a fresh start the game is started as soon as pressing a button on the title screen, while on following starts it will show a Continue/New Game screen with the exit count.

Fully compatible with lx5's BW-RAM+ (NOTE: it's not compatible with MarioE's SRAM+) and it also works fine with the Retry patch's own save system (including both worldpeace's patch and my patch).

You can also change the position of the menu on the screen and more easily edit the menu's text.
